values.note: Forest Service dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 'Camping outside developed campgrounds at any one campsite in excess of fourteen (14) cumulative days within a 28-day period, then relocating the camp within five (5) road miles of the site just occupied without a waiting period of three weeks (21 days)') + Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: dispersed camping 'is free of charge anywhere in the national forest outside of a designated campground'; 'All vehicles must remain on or adjacent to roadways that are open to public travel'), read 2026-10-21

summary: No Forest Service page names Red Run Falls; the forest lists the Stonecoal Dispersed Camping area on FR 209 (Greenbrier RD) and announced FR 209 and Stonecoal reopened 2025-08-14 after the Red Run bridge replacement. Booking set from the forest's dispersed-camping rules: first-come, 14 days in 28 (confirms reservable false / fcfs always; adds the limit). FS road layer: FR 209 'Shavers Fork', suitable for passenger cars. No current Monongahela alert or forest order covers FR 209, 27, 47, 49, 233 or 481 (alerts page read 2026-10-21: closures are on FR 18, 19, 76, 86, 701 and a small Elk Run area). Free fee left, but see the flag on the 2026 Stonecoal fee. Note left as is.
flags: Fee question for a human: AWH's photo of the posted Forest Service 'Notice of Fee Change' (recorded on Stonecoal Campground 511) makes 'Stonecoal Campground single $15' from 2026-01-01. This site is ~1.1 km from the Stonecoal pin at the south end of the same FR 209 corridor, and the entry itself calls it 'the Stonecoal dispersed corridor'. If it is one of Stonecoal's numbered sites, the recorded $0 (from the 2023 forest notice) is out of date and should be $15. No Forest Service page says which sites the fee covers.

Missing website: no Forest Service page for Red Run Falls or Stonecoal (neither is in the Camping & Cabins listing). Best agency page: the FR 209 reopening release https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/newsroom/releases/forest-road-209-stonecoal-dispersed-camp-site-reopen-august-14.

Road, for information: Forest Service road layer (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RoadBasic_01/MapServer/0, queried 2026-10-21): the pin sits on NFSR 209 'SHAVERS FORK', operational maintenance level '3 - SUITABLE FOR PASSENGER CARS', crushed aggregate/gravel. The pin is ~90 m from US 250 / WV 92 at Cheat Bridge.
